answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 5074 Country: Pakistan Title: I made eyebrows, plz tell me z it jaiz in islam? i m dng complet hijab, so? Question: I made eyebrows, plz tell me z it jaiz in islam? i m dng complet hijab, so? Answer ID: 5074 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 375/375=M/1429) It is not right to trim the eyebrows; it is unlawful to change the natural structure. The Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) has cursed the women who remove their face hairs. Now onward you should avoid doing so. However, observing complete hijab is commendable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
